cc:Work.dc:title: Survival predictions and observation-model error
cc:Work.dc:description: Solid curves and bands use proper censoring; dashed curves deliberately treat censoring as failure; dotted curves shorten follow-up. Numerical S12 values and conditional failure probabilities accompany the chapter.
